experiments.hypothesis: On questions using exact Python terms/operators, upweighting BM25 in RRF improves Hit@1 beyond the balanced hybrid 12/15 while preserving Evidence Hit@3 and contextual evidence coverage.
experiments.independent_change: RRF dense_weight=0.7, lexical_weight=1.3; all other retrieval settings identical to baseline
experiments.evaluation: original-question dev Hit@1, Evidence Hit@3, Context Evidence Rate, per-case wins/losses and query latency

experiments.hypothesis: An evidence-only completeness instruction covering every explicit clause/contrast of the user's question improves grounded answer completeness, especially two-part/operator/unit questions, without reducing correct abstention or citation support.
experiments.independent_change: Keep balanced hybrid RRF unchanged and add a general question-coverage instruction to the model's system prompt; no answer gold, case IDs or examples from benchmark are supplied.
experiments.evaluation: real Gemini dev 17-case tool calls, answer grades 0/1/2, citation support and abstention compared with CP5 hybrid Agent

decision_rule: Prioritize factual completeness/grounding and citation support, then Evidence Hit@3 and Hit@1; do not accept a change that materially harms retrieval evidence/abstention. Keep original balanced hybrid if experiments do not improve. Freeze one reproducible configuration before any CP7 test calls.
